title: COSO Reference Audit — Domain E Seed Certification Wave 1
purpose: Verify COSO citation presence, citation accuracy, and principle alignment for all 38 Domain E seeds.

audit_standard.expected_per_item: At least 1 COSO principle citation in ExplanationCorrect for certification
audit_standard.caqs_reference: CAQS v1.0 §4 — mini-lesson standard requires explicit framework citations

overall_result.rationale: Zero citation accuracy errors found. However, 12 of 38 seeds have EC text without explicit COSO principle citations — these need enrichment before certification. All stems and choices are COSO-aligned (no framework misattributions).
overall_result.ec031_coso_erm_note: P1-EC-031 (risk appetite) references COSO IC-IF but concept belongs to COSO ERM (2017). Not an error — risk appetite appears in both frameworks — but citation should specify COSO ERM for precision.

gaps.label: Independence
gaps.note: No seeds cover board/audit committee independence explicitly

gaps.label: Commitment to Competence
gaps.note: Not directly covered by seed inventory

gaps.label: Risk Response
gaps.note: Only 1 seed (ERM risk response) — thin coverage

remediation_required.action: Add explicit COSO principle citation to ExplanationCorrect for each item — format: 'COSO Principle [N]: [label] — [connection to item concept].'
remediation_required.ec031_special: P1-EC-031: use COSO ERM (2017) citation instead of COSO IC-IF

certification_pathway.pre_certification: All 12 citation-deficient items must have COSO/ERM citations added to EC text
certification_pathway.post_certification: All 38 items meet CAQS §4 mini-lesson standard for framework citations
certification_pathway.blocking_note: Citation enrichment is bundled into Wave 1-3 EW fill passes — not a separate certification blocker
